summary: Frontend-only test of the anexo (attachment) status feedback on /inscricao.html. Verified initial hidden state, and behavior after set_input_files on #DOC_FRENTE and #DOC_VERSO. All assertions passed: text contains 'Frente anexado:'/'Verso anexado:' + filename, color is rgb(30,126,52), display becomes block, and status is positioned below its input.
critical_code_review_comments: The container #doc-uploads is display:none by default; status elements only become user-visible when that section is revealed (expected behavior). The bug fix itself for the attachment feedback works correctly across states.
seed_data_creation: Temporary jpeg files created at /tmp/donatelo.jpg and /tmp/donatelo_verso.jpg for set_input_files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note: #doc-uploads parent starts with display:none. To test attachment inputs directly, either force display:block via JS or navigate the form to the step that reveals it. The status elements (#DOC_FRENTE_status, #DOC_VERSO_status) work correctly on change event.
